verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no sandbox, branch, clone, or separate test environment that isolates testing from production data. The nearby features are adjacent controls rather than sandboxing: read-only MCP access, per-user isolated compute instances, SaaS Mode limiting local access, and a general 'develop locally, then scale in the cloud' workflow. A read-only restriction or compute isolation is not the same as a sandbox with separate data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
